title: Lazar recognizes the craft in Billy Meier material

tellings.quote: I think when I described the craft to him and drew it, I think he brought out the Billy Meier stuff.
While hanging out one day, John Lear shows Lazar a tape of Billy Meier, a Swedish ufologist who has been caught in multiple known hoaxes.
tellings.difference: Told by the host rather than Lazar, it calls the material a tape and adds that Meier was caught in hoaxes.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of John Lear bringing out Billy Meier material to show Lazar in Las Vegas around 1989.

as_told.title: Lear shows Lazar Billy Meier tapes

plain: The story is that in 1989, in Las Vegas, Bob Lazar described a flying saucer he says he had seen, and a friend pulled out material that seemed to show the same craft. Lazar is a man who says he was cleared to work on alien craft in the Nevada desert. He tells Michels that when he described and drew the craft for a man named John Lear, Lear "brought out the Billy Meier stuff." Billy Meier is a man known for photos and films he says show alien ships. Michels tells it too, in a documentary episode. He says that while they were hanging out one day, Lear showed Lazar a tape of Meier. Michels calls Meier a "Swedish ufologist who has been caught in multiple known hoaxes." The tellers bring it up because, if true, a craft Lazar says he saw matched one in material from someone else.
